content:
Upscaled Mekanism 32x 是一款 [Faithful](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/faithful-32x) 风格的资源包，为 [Mekanism](https://modrinth.com/mod/mekanism) 模组提供了更高分辨率的纹理。它在保留原版风格的同时提升了视觉清晰度，呈现出更锐利、细节更丰富的 32×32 像素效果。


![](https://imgur.com/uQy3GnK.png) ![](https://imgur.com/A3S2R8q.png)


### **模组支持** * Mekanism Generators * Meknaism Additions * Mekanism Tools * JEI Mekanism Multiblocks

### **致谢** * [Faithful32 Modded](https://github.com/F32Organization/Faithful32-1.12.2) - 本资源包基于 Faithful32 Modded * [Faithful 32x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/faithful-32x) - 部分纹理参考自 Faithful 32x
